verdict.rationale: gstack has its own documented install mechanism: it distinguishes global from vendored installs, has a setup step, and ships an upgrade skill. A community commenter describes the install as a git-clone-and-copy model, which suggests a multi-step process rather than a single command. Missing for 10: a documented one-line install command (package manager, CLI or marketplace), explicit confirmation that skills are active in the next session, and independent hands-on corroboration of the install flow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can install a skill collection with one documented command — a package-manager one-liner, CLI, or in-agent marketplace command — and it is active in my next session

citations.quote: Detects global vs vendored install, runs the upgrade, and shows what's new.
Project-local setup never silently replaces a global install.
its git-clone-and-copy install model works great solo
